demos.title: 力学系ギャラリー（Draft）
demos.description: Six independent calculations (Lorenz, Mandelbrot, logistic map, Game of Life, Gray–Scott, double pendulum) as Drafts that only share their settings: the Agent's "Card を生成" hands them to helpers that write them at the same time, a bird each.

demos.title: MNIST · 分類器くらべ（Draft）
demos.description: Real MNIST digits are loaded and subsampled, and seven classifiers (kNN, logistic regression, an RBF SVM, a random forest, gradient boosting, an MLP and a CNN) wait as Drafts with a shared output type, each in its own Nix environment: the Agent's "Card を生成" hands them to helpers that write them at the same time, a bird each, and then writes the comparison.
